note: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent play-money banknote sprite for a polished children's maths app. A single flat rectangular paper banknote viewed exactly front-on, perfectly horizontal, aspect ratio 2:1. Warm muted sage-green and cream toy currency, rounded corners, tasteful engraved leaf ornaments around the outer border, subtle paper fibre and softly embossed print, high quality storybook 3D illustration, soft upper-left studio light and a very small contact shadow. The large central oval is completely blank light cream, occupying the middle 55% width and 55% height, reserved for an app-rendered denomination. No words, numbers, letters, signatures, flags, portrait, brand or real currency designs. Exactly one note, no stacks, hands or other objects. Actual transparent alpha outside the note; no white rectangle backdrop. Note occupies about 90% canvas width with equal margins, clear straight edges, no perspective or tilt.
coin: Use case: stylized-concept. No words, letters, numerals, currency symbols, portrait, logo, stars or other objects. Exactly one coin centered, circle occupies 86% of square canvas width. True transparent alpha outside the coin; no white/colored backdrop.
